Functions declaration.

bool light_xyl_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info)

Register light xyl server model.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index that model is registered to.

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to light xyl server model context.

Return values:

  • true -- Registration success.

  • false -- Registration failed. Verify parameters.

Returns:

Registration status.

bool light_xyl_setup_server_reg(uint8_t element_index, mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info)

Register light xyl setup server model.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] Element index that model is registered to.

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to light xyl setup server model context.

Return values:

  • true -- Registration success.

  • false -- Registration failed. Verify parameters.

Returns:

Registration status.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t light_xyl_publish(const mesh_model_info_p pmodel_info, light_xyl_t xyl)

Publish light xyl.

Parameters:

  • pmodel_info -- [in] Pointer to light xyl server model context.

  • xyl -- [in] XYL value to publish.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Successfully published.

  • Others -- Publication failed. Validate parameters.

Returns:

Publish status.
